public_payload.normalized_proposition: In 2025 AGI did not materialize, and GPT-5 was underwhelming and did not solve hallucinations.

statement.excerpt: AGI didn’t materialize (contra predictions from Elon Musk and others); GPT-5 was underwhelming, and didn’t solve hallucinations.
statement.document_title: Six (or seven) predictions for AI 2026 from a Generative AI realist

our_interpretation: The retrospective describes 2025 through the publication date, not the remaining days of December.
AGI materializing means a demonstrated system broadly recognized as having general human-level capabilities. Marcus supplies no operational definition.
Not solving hallucinations means factual fabrication remained a demonstrated limitation; it does not mean hallucination rates failed to improve.
Underwhelming expresses an assessment against unspecified expectations. I do not substitute a benchmark threshold for it.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary evidence establishes that GPT-5 continued to hallucinate and that no system had achieved broadly recognized AGI. Supporting the entire bundled claim also requires an identifiable standard for underwhelming.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A broadly recognized AGI achievement before publication or convincing evidence that GPT-5 had eliminated hallucinations would contradict a factual component. Performance gains alone do not refute an unspecified judgment of disappointment.
